To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we observed spiral waves propagating on the electrode during the electrochemical co- deposition of Ag and Sb and the waves were phenomenologically similar to those observed in the Belousov-Zhobotinsky reaction.
we have found that the spiral wave patterns of electrochemically deposited Ag/Sb are driven by the electrochemical co-diffusion process.
we have developed a new method for the fabrication of 3-dimensional superstructures by using a spiral wave-propagating reaction-diffusion system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following three subjects.
the dynamics of spiral waves propagating on the electrode.
a novel electrochemical co-depositing reaction of two metals and the formation of a 3-dimensional spiral waves.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the electrochemical co- deposition process can form a spiral wave pattern, and the spiral waves propagate on the electrode surface.
the co-deposition reaction is a good model system for the BZ reaction, and that the co-deposited metal layers are a good model for the chemical layers in the BZ reaction.
the Ag/Sb co- deposition on the Cu electrode is an excellent example of the wave propagation of a non-linear reaction-diffusion system, which is driven by the electrochemical reaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the electrochemically driven spiral wave propagation is a universal phenomenon, and that the electrochemic co-deposition of Ag and Sb can be a good model for a BZ reaction.
the electrochemical co-precipitation of Ag and Sb on a copper electrode was a good example for a reaction-diffusion system in a solid state.
we have found a new system which can be a model system for the study of the wave-propagation and the formation of the super-structure in the BZ reaction-diffusion system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the co-deposition of Ag and Sb on a copper electrode can be regarded as a model system of the BZ reaction-diffusion system.
a simple chemical reaction can be replaced by a physical one, and the resulting wave-propagation dynamics are similar.
the co-deposition reaction can be controlled by the wave propagation and that the co-deposited structure can be controlled by a combination of the co-deposition and the wave propagation.
